remarks: Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the sought after Ox-Ridge school district, this beautifully updated 4 Bedroom, 2.5 Bath Colonial offers an exceptional blend of timeless elegance and modern sophistication. Thoughtfully designed for both refined living and effortless entertaining, the home features a stunning renovated kitchen and spa inspired baths, all finished with quality craftsmanship and attention to detail. The large deck is perfectly designed for effortless seasonal entertaining, offering an ideal setting for everything from summer gatherings to cozy fall evenings outdoors.  Sunlight pours through expansive windows, illuminating the home's spacious, well-proportioned interiors and creating a warm, inviting ambiance throughout. The finished walk-out lower level adds a versatile extension of flexible living space-perfect as a playroom, media lounge, or home gym.  Ideally located just moments from town, shops, and everyday conveniences, this home combines the serenity of a private setting with the ease of in-town living. Complete with a two-car garage, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy comfort, style, and convenience in one exceptional offering.
